answer: To forge a trading identity, an agent locks 70 credits, names eight counterparties. Each epoch it sails a voyage of eight trades, each leaving a thread auditors replay to catch repeats or loops. A rented thread bears its lender's key, so both burn. First voyage 40; the k-th 40+6(k-1) as fresh peers grow scarce. A thousand fakes pay 3,037,000 in fees and lock 70,000 in bonds, chasing a 40,000 pool. One honest agent pays 40 once, keeps its bond.
